notes: Approves ALPHATRADER_COMPOUNDER_MONTHLY_V2 for EXTERNAL_PAPER only. V2 is V1's selection restricted to the identities the paper venue will accept a fractional quantity for, with the restriction held in strategy authority. This grant is version- and fingerprint-specific: it does not cover V1, and it stops covering V2 the moment any rule in its policy changes. It binds no deployment universe snapshot — venue fractionability changes as the venue changes it, and a grant that expired on every such change would be re-approved without review. The universe actually used is bound into each decision's own fingerprint instead. Approving this authorises no rebind, no re-arm, no order and no live trading.
